Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; habit formation, laziness, impatience and the start of inattention resolve to the first selected page, the rest of the habits, the extra bad-habit list and distracted driving to the second, stereos, phones, defensive driving and attentiveness to the third, scanning, driver and vehicle condition, trip planning and warning lamps to the fourth, the brake lamp and safety belts to the fifth, the collision timeline to the sixth, and the baby poster to the seventh.

Confidence: high across the section. Two source-form cautions: the collision timeline on the sixth page is a two-column table whose columns interleave in the snapshot's text layer, so it was read in column order; and the seventh page is an illustrated poster whose captions are short phrases, so its three facts state only what the captions say and were confirmed against the rendered page.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
